licence.name: Class 5 driver's licence (standard, after the Graduated Driver Licensing Program)

note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshots of the Government of Prince Edward Island's own pages (princeedwardisland.ca answers this egress 403 from Radware, as it did today). Graduated Driver Licensing Program (GDL), snapshot of 15 July 2026 (page published 20 November 2024): an Instruction Driver's Permit from 16; Stage 1 lasts 365 days before the road test, 275 days with a certified driver education program; the road test gives the Class 5 licence with the G decal, Stage 2 lasts 365 days and Stage 3 another 365; the program takes a minimum of three years, or two years and 275 days with driver education. The full licence is so held from 18 years and 275 days, 16 plus the page's own two years and 275 days with driver education (19 without it): the age is the page's minimum added to the permit's age, my arithmetic. Highway Traffic Act Fees Regulations, the Legislative Counsel Office's consolidation current to 11 May 2024 (snapshot of 13 June 2024): s. 8(1) a driver's license issued for a five-year period is $116; Table 5, photographic identification under s. 6.1(1) of the Act $20 for one year and $50 for five, held as the card's two terms, and no charge to a qualifying person without a valid licence (not held, as the form can't say who qualifies). No later consolidation was reached: the live PDF answered 403 and archive.org's CDX reset every connection today, so a change after May 2024 wasn't ruled out. The card's youngest age isn't given and isn't held. Until 2026-10-31 PEI stood blocked because the age falls between birthdays.

sources.title: Government of Prince Edward Island, Graduated Driver Licensing Program (GDL) (archive.org snapshot of 15 July 2026)
sources.said: It takes a minimum of three years to complete the program. If you enroll in a certified driver education program you may be able to complete the GDL program in a minimum of two years and 275 days. ... If you are 16 years of age or older, you may apply for an Instruction Driver's Permit (Class 7 license) ... This period is reduced to 275 days if enrolled in a certified driver education program. ... After you pass the road test, you will be issued your Class 5 driver’s license ... This stage lasts for one full year (365 days) ... Once you successfully complete the second stage, you will enter Stage 3, which lasts another full year (365 days).
